description:
As a customer, I want to change my cart before checking out.

* Increasing the quantity of an item updates that line's total and the cart total.
* Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total.
* Removing the last item shows an empty cart message.
* Cart contents persist after a page refresh.

criteria.text: Increasing the quantity of an item updates that line's total and the cart total.
Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total.
Removing the last item shows an empty cart message.
Cart contents persist after a page refresh.

cases.title: Increasing an item's quantity updates the line total and the cart total
cases.preconditions: A customer is logged in and the cart contains <an item with quantity 1>.
steps: Note the line total of <the item> and the cart total.
Increase the quantity of <the item> to 2.
cases.expected: The line total of <the item> is updated to reflect the new quantity and the cart total is updated accordingly. (The exact recalculated values are not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Removing an item when other items remain removes the line and updates the total
cases.preconditions: A customer is logged in and the cart contains <at least two different items>.
steps: Note the items listed and the cart total.
cases.expected: The removed item no longer appears in the cart list, the other item(s) remain listed, and the cart total is updated. (The exact recalculated total is not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Removing the last item shows the empty cart message
cases.preconditions: A customer is logged in and the cart contains exactly one item: <any single item>.
steps: Remove the only item in the cart.
cases.expected: The item is removed from the list and an empty cart message is shown. (The exact message text is not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Cart contents persist after a page refresh
cases.preconditions: A customer is logged in and the cart contains <at least two items with known quantities>.
steps: Note the items, their quantities and the cart total.
Refresh the page in the browser.
cases.expected: After the refresh the cart still shows the same items with the same quantities and the same cart total.

cases.title: Quantity increase and item removal persist after a page refresh
cases.preconditions: A customer is logged in and the cart contains <at least two items, one of them with quantity 1>.
steps: Increase the quantity of <the item with quantity 1> to 2.
Note the remaining items, their quantities and the cart total.
Refresh the page in the browser.
cases.expected: After the refresh the cart still shows the increased quantity, the removed item is still absent, and the cart total matches the value noted before the refresh.
